column1: # VERIFIED RESULTS -- Phase A2 full-text verification completed 2026-08-17: 46 of 48 parameters were closed out against the 14 source full texts and 43 carry a table/page locator; 2 remain unresolvable assumptions (the ciNPWT institutional net acquisition price and the superficial tunnel length). SSI/ciNPWT risk-threshold Markov CUA; US commercial payer; 2025 USD; monthly cycles; 24-cycle base horizon; 3%/yr discounting; WTP $100000/QALY.

column24: note

column2: SSI-attributable cost multiplier (m_ssi_cost) x all six tranches
column24: PIVOTAL. Dimensionless multiplier scaling ALL SIX Edmiston tranches together, so SSI-attributable cost is ONE bar; the six tranches are deliberately NOT swung separately (that would double-count the same uncertainty). Range spans Pennington's matched increment (0.266) to the deep-SSI value applied to every SSI (1.201).

column2: ciNPWT relative risk (rr_cinpwt) -- correlated arm gap
column24: Correlated 'gap' row: RR is applied to the onset hazard INSIDE the engine (p_ciNPWT = p_control x RR), so this single row moves arm B relative to a fixed arm A and arm ordering can never invert. Lower RR = larger effect = higher INMB, so inmb_low > inmb_high on this row.

2025 USD -- already in the model price year and NOT inflated. One-time cycle-0 toll, arm B only, so INMB moves dollar-for-dollar with it. Also swept in full as analysis axis 2 by run_threshold.py; this bar is the one-way version.

column2: Deep fraction of SSI (frac_deep; frac_sup = 1 - frac_deep)
column24: Varied as a Dirichlet PAIR (group ssi_split): the partner frac_sup is set to 1 - frac_deep at each bound so the split always sums to 1. Total incidence is invariant by construction (the engine sets the total hazard first), so this row moves SSI COMPOSITION only -- cost per SSI and QALY loss per SSI.

Swept via the n_deep= kwarg, NOT via sample -- tunnel width is a layout and the engine RAISES on a disagreeing sample key. Evidence conflict: Urquhart [21] reports PROM recovery by 1 year, McFarland [19] a persisting decrement. Moves the QALY side only (the cost tolls attach to the onset cohort, not tunnel occupancy).
Applied in RECOV to the horizon. Non-zero only in the residual-decrement scenario; arm A accumulates more RECOV time (more SSIs), so a residual decrement favours ciNPWT.
Positive magnitude subtracted from u_well for the whole deep tunnel.

2025 USD -- not inflated. Charged as a cycle-0 toll in ARM A, so it moves the result in the OPPOSITE direction to the device price. $0 base case is the conservative-bias choice (arm B pays the full device cost with no offset).
Swept via the n_sup= kwarg, NOT via sample (see n_tunnel_deep). No source reports a superficial-SSI duration; the 2-6 month range is an assumed span.
Positive magnitude subtracted from u_well for the whole superficial tunnel.
Indexes the 2023 US life table. now sourced to Urquhart 2021 [21] at A2. Enters both arms identically; only the competing-risks attenuation differs.
Cycle 0 only, IDENTICAL in both arms, so it enters the increment only through the competing-risks attenuation of onset -- a very small swing is the correct result.
Sex mix for background mortality. now sourced to Urquhart 2021 [21] at A2. Enters both arms identically.

Expected to swing by ~0: u_well is identical in both arms and the arms' live mass is identical cycle by cycle (mortality is arm-independent), so it cancels from the incremental QALY to machine precision. It scales each arm's QALY LEVEL only. This row is the numerical proof of the BUILD-CONTRACT section 6.7 claim.
CROSS-CHECK -- never costed (Decision 3) and not read by the engine at all. INMB swing is EXACTLY zero. Kept as an explicit zero row so the exclusion is visible rather than silent.
COUNTER -- no cost by plan Decision 3. Read by the engine (populates n_persistent) but multiplies nothing; INMB swing is EXACTLY zero by design.

COUNTER -- no cost by plan Decision 3. Read by the engine (it populates n_reop) but multiplies nothing, so the INMB swing is EXACTLY zero. That is the correct result: Edmiston's payment is an all-cause increment that already contains reoperation, and costing this would double-count.
CROSS-CHECK -- never added to any cost (Decision 3) and not read by the engine. Readmission is already inside Edmiston's all-cause increment. INMB swing EXACTLY zero, by design.
